class.name: BoneClothWind3D
class.description: Blows along the node's -Z axis on every [BoneClothSimulator3D] in the same world. Several winds add up, and hiding the node turns it off. The wind wavers on its own, so hair and clothes keep moving while the character stands still.

members.member: How far the wind's direction drifts from the node's -Z axis. [code]0.0[/code] keeps the direction fixed.
How long the direction takes to drift, in seconds.
How fast the wind wavers. The rate also rises with [member strength].
How hard the wind pushes, as an acceleration. Each simulator scales it by its [code]wind_influence/value[/code].
How much the wind wavers in direction and strength. [code]0.0[/code] blows steadily, and a steady wind makes hair and clothes settle and hold still.
